questions.q: Who does Yahweh tell Ezekiel to prophesy against?
questions.a: Yahweh tells Ezekiel to prophesy against Mount Seir.

questions.q: What does Yahweh say he will do to Mount Seir?
questions.a: Yahweh says he will make Mount Seir a desolation and a horror.

questions.q: What did the people of Mount Seir do that is bringing the judgment of Yahweh upon them?
questions.a: The people of Mount Seir were hostile to the people of Israel, and poured them out into the hands of the sword.

questions.q: According to Yahweh, what will pursue the people of Mount Seir, and why?
questions.a: Bloodshed will pursue the people of Mount Seir because they did not hate bloodshed.

questions.q: What will fill the mountains in the area of Mount Seir?
questions.a: The mountains in the area of Mount Seir will be filled with its dead.

questions.q: For how long will the desolation of Mount Seir last?
questions.a: The desolation of Mount Seir will be a perpetual desolation.

questions.q: What did the people of Mount Seir say about the two nations of Yahweh’s people Israel?
questions.a: The people of Mount Seir said that the two nations would become theirs.

questions.q: What did Yahweh hear the people of Mount Seir saying against him?
questions.a: Yahweh heard the people of Mount Seir boasting against Yahweh and saying many things against him.

questions.q: What will the entire earth do when the people of Mount Seir are desolated?
questions.a: The entire earth will rejoice when the people of Mount Seir are desolated.

questions.q: What did the people of Mount Seir do when the people of Israel were desolated?
questions.a: The people of Mount Seir rejoiced when the people of Israel were desolated.

questions.q: Yahweh declares that all of what area will become a desolation?
questions.a: Yahweh declares that Mount Seir and all of Edom will become a desolation.

questions.q: What will the people of Mount Seir and Edom know when Yahweh judges them?
questions.a: The people of Mount Seir and Edom will know that the Lord is Yahweh when Yahweh judges them.

commentary.text: Ezek. 35:1-9 All who have God against them, have the word of God against them. Those that have a constant hatred to God and his people, as the carnal mind has, can only expect to be made desolate for ever.

Ezek. 35:10-15 When we see the vanity of the world in the disappointments, losses, and crosses, which others meet with, instead of showing ourselves greedy of worldly things, we should sit more loose to them. In the multitude of words, not one is unknown to God; not the most idle word; and the most daring is not above his rebuke. In the destruction of the enemies of the church, God designs his own glory; and we may be sure that he will not come short of his design. And when the fulness of the Jews and Gentiles shall come into the church, all antichristian opposers shall be destroyed.
